epics.title: Product Discovery & UX/UI
epics.description: Identify embroidery operators, map their digitizing workflow and validate a prototype for import, stitch preview and export.

epics.title: C++20 Stitch Core Foundation
epics.description: Define the core boundaries, error model, build targets, test fixtures and interfaces for future platform bindings.

epics.title: Computational Geometry
epics.description: Define contracts for paths, polygon operations, tolerances and coordinate units. Validate edge cases with reproducible fixtures.

epics.title: Stitch Generation Algorithms
epics.description: Specify running, satin and fill stitch behavior, sequencing constraints and validation against representative fabric and machine settings.

epics.title: DST & Machine Format Export
epics.description: Define machine format limits, validate exported stitch sequences and compare outputs with known samples and machine results.

epics.title: Native iOS Application
epics.description: Plan SwiftUI import, preview, editing and export flows around a stable core binding and platform file handling.

epics.title: Native Android Application
epics.description: Plan Kotlin import, preview, editing and export flows around a stable core binding and Android storage conventions.

epics.title: Machine Learning & Computer Vision
epics.description: Define a Python and PyTorch evaluation pipeline for optional image segmentation and digitizing suggestions.

epics.title: Security, Quality & CI/CD
epics.description: Establish repository governance, automated delivery checks, vulnerability triage, notification routing and access controls.

epics.title: Production Validation & UAT
epics.description: Agree on operator acceptance criteria and validate representative designs on supported embroidery machines.

sprint_zero.title: Prototype the import, preview and export flow
sprint_zero.objective: As an embroidery operator, I want to preview the steps from source artwork to an export so I can flag missing decisions early.
sprint_zero.description: Build a clickable prototype using sample artwork and record where an operator needs feedback about file validity or machine limits.
criteria: Show artwork import, stitch preview and export confirmation
Cover one invalid file and one machine limit scenario
sprint_zero.testing: Walk through both scenarios with a reviewer and capture observations.
sprint_zero.done: Link the prototype, feedback and agreed revisions.

sprint_zero.title: Record core and application architecture decisions
sprint_zero.objective: Define the boundaries between the core, platform clients and future vision tools.
sprint_zero.description: Record proposed data contracts, coordinate units, platform binding strategy and error handling.
criteria: Publish architecture decisions with tradeoffs and open questions
sprint_zero.testing: Review contracts against the prototype flow and sample machine constraints.
sprint_zero.done: Record reviewer agreement and link follow up decisions.

sprint_zero.title: Configure repository governance
sprint_zero.objective: Define how changes and security reports enter the repository.
sprint_zero.description: Confirm maintainers, review expectations, Actions settings and vulnerability reporting channels.
criteria: Document review and issue triage responsibilities
Review branch rules after baseline CI succeeds
sprint_zero.testing: Walk through a sample review and a private report route.
sprint_zero.done: Record settings and link to repository policies.

sprint_zero.title: Verify engineering automation and Project access
sprint_zero.objective: Make issue intake, sprint reporting and escalation reproducible.
sprint_zero.description: Set up Project credentials, run the automation smoke test and record Telegram delivery if configured.
criteria: A sample issue reaches the correct board column
A rerun preserves issues and notification records
sprint_zero.testing: Run the repository and Project smoke procedures in the operations runbook.
sprint_zero.done: Record evidence and any remaining credential requirements.

sprint_zero.title: Establish the CMake and GoogleTest foundation
sprint_zero.objective: Provide a repeatable local and CI build for C++20.
sprint_zero.description: Create a minimal toolchain fixture that exercises compiler and test discovery.
criteria: Configure, build and run CTest on a supported runner
Document how to add a source or test target
sprint_zero.testing: Run the standard and sanitizer configurations.
sprint_zero.done: Link successful build evidence and the local commands.

sprint_zero.title: Validate CI quality checks and failure reporting
sprint_zero.objective: Make build and quality results visible during review.
sprint_zero.description: Validate format, static analysis, secret scanning and failure annotations.
criteria: A successful run lists the checks that executed
A controlled failure includes an actionable link
sprint_zero.testing: Use a disposable pull request to demonstrate a failing check and recovery.
sprint_zero.done: Record both runs and confirm expected alerts.
